meals.name: Spaghetti Bolognese :)
meals.instructions: Cook spaghetti. In another pan, sauté onion and garlic, add ground beef, cook until browned. Add tomato sauce, simmer for 20 minutes. Serve with spaghetti.

meals.name: Chicken Curry
meals.instructions: Sauté onion, garlic, and ginger. Add chicken pieces, cook until lightly browned. Stir in curry powder, add coconut milk, and simmer until chicken is cooked.

meals.name: Caesar Salad
meals.instructions: Chop lettuce, toss with dressing, croutons, and grated Parmesan.

meals.name: Vegetable Stir Fry
meals.instructions: Heat sesame oil, sauté garlic and ginger. Add vegetables, stir fry for 5 minutes, add soy sauce, and serve hot.

meals.name: Pancakes
meals.instructions: Mix dry and wet ingredients separately, then combine. Pour batter onto a hot pan, cook until bubbles form, flip and cook the other side.

meals.name: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
meals.instructions: Butter the bread, place cheese between slices, grill until golden brown.

meals.name: Tomato Soup
meals.instructions: Cook onion and garlic, add chopped tomatoes and broth, simmer until soft. Blend until smooth, add cream before serving.

meals.name: Beef Tacos
meals.instructions: Cook beef with seasoning. Fill taco shells with beef, lettuce, cheese, and salsa.

meals.name: Chocolate Brownies
meals.instructions: Mix dry and wet ingredients, pour into a baking tin, and bake at 180°C for 25-30 minutes.

meals.name: Fried Rice
meals.instructions: Scramble eggs, add vegetables and garlic, stir fry, then add rice and soy sauce.
